headline: Passage and Berm Ablaze; Wardens Firm at Nevish Line
war_summary: Fighting has shifted back to two old battlegrounds since the morning edition. Callahan's Passage, now eight Warden works against two Colonial, is again the war's loudest sector, with eight events in the last two hours and the latest filed at 11:55; the day's toll there stands above ten thousand six hundred Colonial and eleven thousand five hundred Warden casualties. Palantine Berm, still seven Warden posts, has likewise stirred, three events in two hours against thirty-three in the day, thirteen of them logged as the sitting owner losing ground. The Nevish Line has firmed for the Wardens at six posts against two Colonial, where the previous count stood five and three, though thirty-nine events in the day and a fresh engagement at 9:47 keep it unsettled. Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest furnace, seven Colonial works against two unclaimed, with five thousand five hundred Colonial and nine thousand two hundred Warden casualties in the day. Stlican Shelf holds seven Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed, an event filed at this edition's hour. Stonecradle stands seven Colonial to two Warden, Mooring County's twelve Warden works quiet. No victory has been declared.
